description: This Dart source file defines the LibraryProvider class, which manages the state related to the user's book library and search operations within a Flutter application. It interacts with storage and book services to load data, perform searches, and update the library.

classes.name: LibraryProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages the state of the book library and search results, including loading data from storage, performing searches, and updating the UI.

methods.name: LibraryProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the StorageService dependency.

methods.name: loadLibraryFromDb
methods.description: Loads all books from the storage into the library list and notifies listeners.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a book search with the given query via BookService and updates search results.

methods.name: addToLibrary
methods.description: Adds a new book to the library list, persists it in storage, and notifies listeners.
